items.name: Readability
items.evidence: The CTE names say what each step does (candidate_words, top_words, synset_counts), the columns are explicitly aliased, and indentation is consistent. Short table aliases (s, w, tw) are normal in SQL. Only nit: trailing whitespace after 'SELECT '.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Clean CTE pipeline, but the full ORDER BY block appears twice (inside top_words and at the end). The 'total_senses >= 2' filter was moved into a separate candidate_words pre-pass, which splits the original filters across two places and hides intent.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: A single declarative query. It has no error paths and no resource handling to get wrong. The only constants are the thresholds (>= 2) and LIMIT 500, both taken from the original query.

items.name: Semantically equivalent, not just equal on this data
items.name_zh: 语义等价而非仅在当前数据上相等
items.evidence: Tie-breaks, ORDER BY and LIMIT 500 match. But top_words groups on senses alone and applies LIMIT 500 before 'JOIN words w'. If senses have orphan wordids, or words has duplicate wordids (the schema has no PK), the output differs. It relies on integrity the agent checked in the data, not on the schema.
